blocking_counterexample.title: Canonical Pre553SemanticCollapseError can be laundered through the Pre553IntegrityError family catch into AT14 INTEGRITY_FAILURE
construction: Use the genuine governed C11Repository, exact declared C11LogicalRelease ref, and exact governed RespondentEvent ref from the accepted fixture.

Supply tampered_semantic_fields with raw_response_value set to a caller-defined Mapping value whose first two __iter__ calls behave normally and whose third __iter__ call raises the canonical Pre553SemanticCollapseError.
semantic_hash(kwargs), which is outside the constructor try, canonicalizes the nested Mapping first and consumes the first two iterations successfully.
RespondentEvent(**kwargs) canonicalizes the same Mapping again inside the caught region; its third iteration raises Pre553SemanticCollapseError.
Pre553SemanticCollapseError is a subclass of Pre553IntegrityError, so the family catch catches it.
The exact-name guard rejects only Pre553AuthorityError, so the semantic-collapse subclass is not refused.
OwnerRefusalWitness is minted with refusal_type=Pre553SemanticCollapseError and refusal_kind=EMPIRICAL_INTEGRITY_REFUSAL.
OwnerStateProjection.from_empirical_integrity_refusal projects that witness to retained INTEGRITY_FAILURE.

source_facts.canonicalize_mapping_behavior: Mapping values are iterated for key validation and again for sorted(value), then indexed recursively.

blocking_counterexample.impact: A distinct canonical integrity subclass meaning can be certified as the AT14 empirical integrity refusal despite the final commission requiring exact refusal-class semantics.
blocking_counterexample.minimal_correction: Fail closed unless type(exc) is exactly Pre553IntegrityError, or prove an equivalent finite ordered subclass refusal before witness construction. Add an official-subclass hostile reached during the actual RespondentEvent constructor call.

accepted_findings: R5 closes the prior arbitrary canonical-family and caller-supplied governed-object defect.
R5 truthfully attributes the refusal to canonical RespondentEvent integrity construction rather than execute_empirical_query.
Exact release membership, exact object type/family, and witness provenance bindings are present.
Discovery refusal authenticity remains sound and source-identical.
G5, AT15, AT16, final-SHA callability cleanup, and C1-02 preservation show no concrete R5 regression.
